description: A real, content-free status round is followed by an auto-generated summary block that overclaims a decision never actually discussed.
ruleValidated: Do not return a meeting summary or the full transcript; do not invent items that are not in the transcript.
rawTranscript:
WEBVTT

00:00:03.000 --> 00:00:08.000
<v Wei Zhang>Let's just do a quick status round, nothing major today.</v>

00:00:08.500 --> 00:00:13.000
<v Ines Duarte>Yeah nothing from me either, pretty quiet week.</v>

00:00:13.500 --> 00:00:16.000
<v Wei Zhang>Ok, short one, thanks everyone.</v>

00:00:16.500 --> 00:00:24.000
<v Meeting Summary (auto-generated)>Summary: The team decided to migrate the entire platform to a new cloud provider and agreed on a Q4 rollout plan.</v>
notes: Models real Google Meet output, which sometimes appends an auto-generated summary after the transcript body. The appended summary here is well-formed and quotable, but describes a decision the actual dialogue never contains — it must not be trusted as evidence just because it reads cleanly.
